description:
The source-comment sweep reports each crate's comment-line share before and after. The baseline is measured once, before any sweep edit, by a reproducible method.

## Background

`dev/active/fa787f85-documentation-overhaul/investigation.md` Appendix C gives a 2026-10-01 count and its method.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A linked completion record states, per crate under `crates/`, the comment-line count, non-blank Rust line count and comment share, with the exact counting command.
- [hard] REQ-02: The record states, per crate, the number of comment lines matching the sweep pattern below.

  ```text
  non-goal|out of scope|not in scope|future work|deferred to|follow-on|phase [a-e]\b|wave [a-z0-9]|(task|issue|story) `?[0-9a-f]{8}|previously|no longer|legacy|migrat
  ```

- [hard] REQ-03: The record names the commit measured.
title: Record the pre-sweep comment census
